author: alice@example.com
diff:
+ Replaced the bounded image cache with a persistent in-memory dictionary keyed by image hash.
+ Cached image objects are retained for reuse but are no longer evicted after processing.
+ Removed the previous cache size limit and cleanup logic.
+ This change keeps processed image objects referenced in memory for the lifetime of the worker.
